page.layout: One page of running text in a single justified column; running head above the text; page number at the top left; catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Ainaf.

main_text.p: & omnia expendens diligenter, sic reperi: Cùm concors cum ordinibus agri vicini civitas ageret, ac foedera in certos annos percussa identidem prorogaret, prope ut una utrorumque Respublica videretur, ex consensu sociorum eos profluxisse, rectius atque aequalius expediundi juris, & tenendae concordiae, conservandaeque quietis publicae causa: electos esse ex spectatissimis & integerrimis quibusque in civitate, interdum etiam ex iis, qui e nobilitate agrariâ in urbem commigrarant, & jus civitatis acquiserant: quinos & quinos in collegio fuisse perannos amplius ix[?], eosque incerta ratione, prout operam suam probassent, aut grati Reipubl. essent, aut casus daret, vel permutatos successoribus: vel per annos complures, quod erat frequens, continuatos: praetoriam potestatem tenuisse in omnes per agrum habitantes, eaque usos totius provinciae, id est, agri & civitatis nomine, edictisque nomen senatus cum nomine suo subscripsisse, & civitatis sigillo edicta & literas signasse: jus dixisse iis, qui fraudem sibi fieri apud

page.notes: The scan is slightly cropped at the left and bottom; a faint library stamp at the bottom right was left out. "amplius ix" is hard to read (possibly "lx") and is marked [?]. "agrariâ" is printed with a mark over the a, kept as shown. The word "successoribus:" is printed with a colon-like point before "vel" and kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s; u/v and i/j are normalised.
